note: Extract of the French repairability index (indice de réparabilité). National French score, not an EU repairability score.
title: Repairability rankings from the French repairability index
method: Models sorted by the score of the French repairability index (indice de réparabilité, Code de l'environnement, Art. L. 541-9-2) as published by the company that placed them on the French market. No own rating. Same score, same rank; ranks consecutive; within a score, longer spare parts supply first, then name. Entries with the same model name or the same barcode count as one model (latest entry). Rows without a valid GTIN, with a wrong check digit and older calculations of the same model are removed.
notRanked: Washing machines (indice de durabilité instead since 8 April 2025) and smartphones (no French index since 7 July 2025) are still in the dataset but not ranked.
